settings.title: Model Providers
settings.description: Configure provider base URL, key, and model.

settings.noProviders: No providers yet — click above to add one
settings.missingFields: Name, Base URL and model are required
settings.embeddingBuiltinHint: The embedding model (used by RAG retrieval) is built-in and independent of providers; only endpoint and key can be overridden
settings.embeddingBaseUrlPlaceholder: Leave empty to reuse the Base URL above
settings.exportDesc: Import "{name}" into cc-switch (Claude Code provider switcher)
settings.exportDeepLinkHint: Requires the cc-switch desktop app; it will prompt to confirm the import
settings.emptyProvidersHint: Add a model provider (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, or a local model) with its Base URL and API Key to start chatting
settings.activated: Switched to "{name}" — new conversations will use it
settings.footerHint: Providers are stored under your account and switchable anytime; export to cc-switch to reuse them in Claude Code

roles.title: Role Management
roles.subtitle: Manage AI assistant preset roles
roles.systemPromptPlaceholder: Describe how this role should behave...
roles.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the purpose of this role...
roles.resourceHint: Single PDF / Markdown / plain-text file (≤20MB). Auto-chunked and embedded on upload; retrieved on demand during chat.
roles.resourceIndexWarning: File uploaded, but indexing failed: the PDF looks like a scan (no extractable text) or exceeds the page limit. Upload a text-based PDF or trim it.
roles.resourceScanned: This PDF looks like a scan with no extractable text; please upload a text-based version
roles.resourceAuthoritativeHint: Authoritative source: preferred in retrieval and used to resolve conflicts between versions (one per role)
roles.builtinHint: Built-in roles: you can edit the basic info and upload skills/resources (uploads override builtin skills with the same id). Built-in roles cannot be deleted.
roles.noCustomRolesHint: Create a custom role with its own prompt, skills and knowledge
roles.missingFields: Role ID and display name are required.
roles.suggestionsPlaceholder: One question per line, shown on the new-chat welcome screen (max 6)
roles.duplicateContent: An identical file already exists — no need to upload again
roles.overwriteConfirm: "{name}" already exists. Overwrite it? The old content will be replaced.
roles.selectRoleHint: Select a role on the left to view and edit
roles.readonlyHint: Shared roles are maintained by admins and read-only to you: you can use them, but not edit.
roles.publishHint: Published roles become visible (read-only) to all users; unpublish to make it private again
roles.publishSkillHint: Publish this skill to the global library (admin only); the role's own copy is kept
roles.publishFailed: Failed to publish to the global library
roles.publishExistsConfirm: "{name}" already exists in the global library. Overwrite with the current version?
roles.pickerDesc: Pick from the global library or your other roles; saving mounts them to this role, unchecking removes them.
roles.pickerEmpty: Nothing available in the library yet

admin.title: Global Resource Library
admin.description: Maintain global skills and MCP servers: built-in roles pick them up automatically; custom roles reference them from the library.
admin.skillsHint: Uploaded skills enter the global library: built-in roles include them automatically, custom roles reference them via "Select from library".
admin.deleteSkillConfirm: Delete global skill "{name}"? Roles referencing it will lose it immediately.
admin.mcpHint: Available to built-in roles automatically; custom roles reference them via "Select from library".
admin.mcpDialogDesc: Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP / SSE URL) or local command (stdio, runs on the server)
admin.mcpHeaders: Headers (optional, one per line, Key: Value)
admin.mcpEnv: Environment variables (optional, one per line, Key: Value)
